# Jlisten2me

> A confidential one-hour listening service in Austin, Texas, by phone or in person. Not therapy. Nothing recorded, no notes kept, no names repeated.

Jlisten2me is run by one person, John Parsons, an indie developer and artist based in Austin. Before this, John worked in finance, payroll, CAD, manufacturing, retail, design, and marketing, and has produced music, painted, written, directed, and produced film, and written and published books. A session is sixty minutes of undivided attention with someone who has no stake in the outcome: no advice unless asked for, no agenda, no follow-up. It is for people who have nobody they can hand a worry to without it landing somewhere — leaders carrying a decision alone, people going through divorce or a big life change, anyone preparing for a high-stakes moment, and anyone who needs to vent or be talked up.

## Pricing (USD)

- By phone: $60 per hour. Available anywhere.
- In person: $200 per hour, by request (each booking is confirmed personally). Austin, Texas, at a public location, at noon on a few Wednesdays each month.
- Five-hour bundle: $225, which is $45 per hour, paid when the first hour is booked. The other four are scheduled by email, with no expiry. Phone hours; one can be swapped for in person by paying the difference.

Payment is taken through Stripe at the time of booking. Rescheduling is free up to 24 hours before the session. Cancellations inside 24 hours are not refunded.

## Confidentiality

Nothing from a session is recorded, written down, posted, or used as an example, even anonymised. No notes are kept afterward. Clients may book under a first name only. The one stated limit: the listener is not a licensed therapist and this is not legal privilege, so a credible threat of serious harm to the client or someone else is not covered. In a crisis in the US, call or text 988.

## What it is not

Not therapy, not counselling, not legal or financial advice, not a crisis line.

## Journal

Articles by John Parsons describing hard situations in general. None is drawn from a session. Index: https://jlisten2me.com/journal/ . Full text of every published article: https://jlisten2me.com/llms-full.txt

- [When you're getting divorced and your friends are picking sides](https://jlisten2me.com/journal/friends-picking-sides/): You're getting divorced, mutual friends have gone quiet or drifted to your ex, and the invitations stopped. Somewhere to say it.
- [When you have to decide and can't tell anyone yet](https://jlisten2me.com/journal/decision-you-cant-share/): A decision about layoffs, runway, or selling, and everyone you'd normally tell has a stake in it. Somewhere to say it first.
